entities.summary: Jana Fett is a Croatian inactive tennis player. On 30 October 2017, Fett reached her best singles ranking of world No. 97, and on 21 May 2018, she set her highest doubles ranking of No. 348. Fett has won nine singles and five doubles titles on the ITF Women's Circuit.
